actions.action: Select GitHub Actions as the GitHub Pages publishing source.
prerequisites: Continuity update is committed to main
Repository content is approved for public access
evidence_required: Deploy BizTrust Guide workflow run URL
stop_conditions: Pages environment or workflow permissions are not approved
actions.fallback: Leave the repository undeployed and continue local preview only.

actions.action: Verify the deployed site against the approved main commit and record deployment evidence.
stop_conditions: Deployed SHA differs from approved main
Any required asset or interaction is broken
actions.fallback: Do not declare the site live; open a defect Work Package.

actions.action: Create and link the canonical GitHub Work Package issue and project fields.
evidence_required: Project item with lifecycle, risk, authority and evidence fields
stop_conditions: Issue scope conflicts with the active Work Package
actions.fallback: Remain in WAIT_FOR_AUTHORITY and retain the repository checkpoint.
